title: aaj shaahe karbala ka dilbar paida hua
body:
aaj shaahe karbala ka dilruba paida hua
malike har do sara zainulleba paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
muttaqi zahid namazi sabir o abid saqi
yaadgaare mustafa o murtaza paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
mustafa hai shaad aur hyder bohat qush'haal hai
aaj choutha jaanasheene mustafa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
shaad hai hur o malak masroor hai qairunnisa
aaj pota fatima ka chaand sa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrate shabbir o abbase alambardaar ka
aaj dunya me bhateeja laadla paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
shor hai salwaat ka ghul hai mubarak baad ka
noore chashme mustafa salle ala paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrate ayyub sharminda hai jis ke sabr se
aaj wo aalam me faqre ambiya paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
ummate aasi ka beda paar karne ke liye
aaj farzande shahe karbobala paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
zainabo kulsoom qush hai shehr bano shaad hai
aaj pehla dilruba shabbir ka paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hazireene bazm ka bar aaye ya rab mud'dua
sadqa is moulood ka jo mailaqa paida hua
